role_summary: AI Engineer role requires delivery of safe, measurable AI features with clear quality and cost controls.
top_priorities: Define and track quality metrics for retrieval and response accuracy
Implement model and prompt versioning with rollback
Deploy monitoring for latency, token cost, and user feedback
Harden safety controls and red-team testing
Ship one production AI feature with controlled rollout

day_0_30: Define use case boundaries and success criteria
Create evaluation dataset and baseline scoring
day_31_60: Implement retrieval and prompt tuning cycle
day_61_90: Release production feature with canary rollout
Run post-release quality and cost review

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Insufficient ground truth data for evaluation
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Create labeled validation set with SME review
Lock prompt versions and regression tests

assumptions: Current systems can expose ticket metadata safely
Stakeholders can review weekly pilot outputs
